name: Court ceasefire rulings on the 15 km Japan map, paid in Legitimacy instead of Favor (owner decision R-1): the Ashikaga human (Legitimacy 70) petitions through EXECUTE_SCRIPT and pays a third of the Gold/Legitimacy cost (34/2). Turn 1: a war forced between two houses with the same city count is petitioned; the AI accepts (+5 Legitimacy), and at turn 2 peace is made at once with MakePeaceWith(b, true) with a 30-turn truce. Turn 2: Ouchi-Otomo (R01) is petitioned and Ouchi refuses a shogun ruling: Legitimacy -45 (below 30: cannot petition, low flags; the high/low flags are toggled to check the +10% / -10% Gold and Culture, owner decision S) and a 30-turn order to subdue Ouchi (R-2); Otomo, at war with Ouchi, joins at once and the human joins from the panel (war-weariness anchor flags). At turn 13 a war forced inside the truce is undone at turn 14; the order is then shortened and ends at turn 15. City captures and their rewards are covered on the stubs only (tests/test_court_arbitration.py)
